t.why: It administers most of Western Sahara and claims it as its own. It sits where Africa meets Europe.
t.rel: Algeria cut ties with it in 2021 over Western Sahara, and their border has been closed since 1994. When it established ties with Israel in 2020, the United States recognized its claim to Western Sahara. With Spain, the Spanish enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla on the African side and migration are at stake.
t.know: At the 2022 World Cup it became the first African team to reach the semifinals.
t.etext: It has the world's largest reserves of phosphate for fertilizer. Car assembly, aerospace parts and tourism have grown fast, and the port of Tanger Med is a Mediterranean logistics hub.
